name: Louis van Gaal
scopeNote: Manager profile of Louis van Gaal across two counted spells: Ajax (28 September 1991 to 30 June 1997: Eredivisie 1993-94 to 1995-96, UEFA Champions League 1994-95) and Barcelona (1 July 1997 to 20 May 2000: La Liga 1997-98 and 1998-99). Dates from the managerial table of the English Wikipedia article. Excluded: the Netherlands 2000-01, Barcelona 2002-03, and the later spells (AZ, Bayern, Manchester United, Netherlands 2014, Netherlands 2022), which are outside this profile's era and were not researched in this run. Style: the evidence supports a possession-based, attacking side built on total-football principles at Ajax, with youth players. The Ajax 1994-95 team profile relies on this spell.

spellsCounted.reason: Three Eredivisie titles and the 1994-95 Champions League: the Ajax side he is known for.
La Liga 1997-98 and 1998-99 and the 1997 Super Cup.
